quarterly_data.signal: Sandisk's June 2025 prospectus reports revenue by end market: Cloud end-market revenue was $747 million in the nine months ended March 28, 2025 versus $155 million a year earlier, after $325 million in fiscal 2024, $500 million in fiscal 2023 and $1,264 million in fiscal 2022 (total revenue $5,454 million for the nine months; $6,663 million in fiscal 2024). Customer concentration: the top 10 customers accounted for 43% of net revenue in the nine months ended March 28, 2025 (41% a year earlier) and 41%, 47% and 47% in fiscal 2024, 2023 and 2022; no customer reached 10% in fiscal 2024 or the nine months, while one customer accounted for 15% in fiscal 2023 and 11% in fiscal 2022.
quarterly_data.figure: Cloud revenue $747 million (nine months to March 28, 2025) vs $155 million; top 10 customers 43%; one customer 15% (fiscal 2023), 11% (fiscal 2022)
